about_the_game:
This is a post-apocalyptic cyber-themed, sci-fi, immortal cultivation and treasure-hunting game.

Gameplay:

Career Selection: Players can choose from one of six basic classes, each with unique traits.

Qualification Selection: When creating a character, you will be randomly assigned multiple qualifications, and two of them will become your character's fixed qualifications.

Cultivation Realms: Players can advance through a total of 10 realms by defeating monsters, each with 10 levels.

Each realm requires a breakthrough battle, and only after completing the breakthrough can you advance.

Kung Fu Skills: Players can learn and use 5 main skills, each with 2 sub-skills.

Equipment: Your character has 10 equipment slots for equipping various equipment.

Equipment has different qualities, with higher quality possessing more stats.

Equipment Modification: Equipment can be repaired, disassembled, and upgraded through modification. Upgraded equipment can improve its stats.

Psionic Transformation: Equipment can be enhanced through various psionic transformations, including engraving, refining, fusion, enchanting, and smelting.

These transformations ultimately improve the equipment's stats.

Character Favorability: The game features numerous random NPC characters, each of which can have its favorability increased.

Increasing favorability grants additional interactions with these characters, including gift giving, dating, and dual cultivation.

Special Gameplay:

KTV: Sing at a KTV venue. Earn your Taoist partner's favor by listening to your singing, and then practice Dual Cultivation with them.

Dual Cultivation Gameplay:

You can practice Dual Cultivation with your Taoist partner in three different locations, including at least twenty different Dual Cultivation moves.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 18 years old.
This game contains nudity and sexually suggestive content.
Sexual scenes include:
-Normal sex, oral sex, and breast intercourse
-No sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug and alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
There are music bar scenes in the game, but no drinking content
